decisions_made: Exploring is a ranking, not a filter: #136's exclusion of non-goal holding actions conflicted with decision 2 and was turned into a demotion (#139).

Novelty demotion applies within each tier-3 group (approach / holding / look_at) rather than above the group order; novelty-first made the baseline use the spawn landmarks before walking. Josh's reviewer accepted the PR with this reading.
Blocked targets need two stalls and count holding verbs only beyond 3 m: one stall can be timing (a perception 290 ticks after the choice) and the well's use anchor is 1.9-2.0 m from its position.
The default model stays Qwen3-0.6B / baseline (handoff item C).
